# VerifiedDomainAuthority.com

Independent reference on domain-based proof of authority.

## Canonical Resource

[Home](https://verifieddomainauthority.com/)

## Purpose

VerifiedDomainAuthority.com documents how domains can provide verifiable proof of authority for published statements and artifacts, with a focus on ownership, editorial control, publication integrity, and revocation discipline.

## Repository

[Verified Domain Authority Evidence Repository](https://github.com/semantic-infrastructure/verifieddomainauthority-evidence)
